title: Asteroid Collision
statement_md:
Asteroids move at the same speed. Positive values move right, negative values move left. When two meet, the smaller one explodes (equal sizes both explode). Return the asteroids that remain.

**Function:** `asteroidCollision(asteroids)`

**Input:** one JSON value per parameter, in the order above. **Output:** the returned value as JSON.
hints: Think about which element has to wait until a later element is seen.
Keep candidates in order. Pop when a new element resolves the ones on top.
Data structure: a stack (Python list used with append and pop).
